# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-31

This release introduces fast, checksum-based full-library synchronization for
Xteink X4 Pro.

## Added

- A compact server manifest containing every EPUB path, size, and SHA-256 checksum.
- Byte-for-byte EPUB downloads directly from the library sync service.
- Size and SHA-256 verification on the reader before an existing book is replaced.

## Improved

- Full-library comparison uses one manifest request instead of traversing paginated OPDS feeds.
- Only new or content-changed books are downloaded.
- Reading progress is preserved when a synchronized EPUB is updated.

## Fixed

- Existing synchronized books are never removed when any download or verification step fails.

## Notes

- This release is for Xteink X4 Pro.
- The configured Calibre server credentials authenticate both the manifest and book downloads.
